title: Sobolev Minimizers for Critical Vectorial $p$-Laplacian Problems
summary: We study minimizers of the optimal Sobolev quotients for the critical embeddings $D^{1,p}(\mathbb R^N;\mathbb R^m)\hookrightarrow L^{p^*}(\mathbb R^N;\mathbb R^m)$ and $W^{1,p}(Ω;\mathbb R^m)\hookrightarrow L^{p^*}(Ω;\mathbb R^m)$. In the whole space, we classify all minimizers as $\boldsymbol u=\boldsymbol c\,U_{δ,x_0}$, where $\boldsymbol c\neq\boldsymbol0$ and $U_{δ,x_0}$ is an Aubin--Talenti bubble. On bounded domains and for $λ>0$, we equip $W^{1,p}(Ω;\mathbb R^m)$ with $ \|\boldsymbol u\|_λ^p :=\int_Ω \bigl(|D\boldsymbol u|^p+λ|\boldsymbol u|^p\bigr) $. Using scalar attainment results,…
